description: A smooth tabletop is in front of you with a small mint-green slime lump with white foam beads near the center-right, a clear plastic container off to the right, and a tiny white scrap to the left. The right hand reaches to the slime, lifts it into the palm, and repeatedly squeezes and compresses it—curling the fingers inward and then loosening—while subtly rotating it; the left hand stays nearby, relaxed and not touching the slime.
